CLI reference

Anki as code commands and options
Categories:
  • Project

Command usage, aliases, options, and Anki API request schemas.

anki_as_code

Export and reconcile Anki collections as TOML

Usage:
  anki_as_code [command]

Available Commands:
  api         Invoke upstream Anki services using protobuf JSON or TOML
  col         Inspect and manage Anki collections
  config      Inspect and manipulate collection configuration files
  help        Help about any command
  server      Manage the native Anki server

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for anki_as_code

Use "anki_as_code [command] --help" for more information about a command.

Request: anki.generic.Empty
Response: anki.generic.Empty

Usage:
  anki_as_code api ankidroid flush-all-queries [flags]

Flags:
      --backend string         Existing backend TCP endpoint or Unix socket path
      --collection string      Offline .anki2 database or .colpkg archive
  -h, --help                   help for flush-all-queries
      --input string           Request file, or - for stdin (default "-")
      --input-format string    Request encoding: json or toml (default "json")
      --no-write-back          Disable offline archive write-back
      --output-format string   Response encoding: json or toml (default "json")
      --timeout duration       Input, startup and request timeout (default 30s)
      --write-back             Write offline archives back on close (default true)

anki_as_code col

Inspect and manage Anki collections

Usage:
  anki_as_code col [flags]
  anki_as_code col [command]

Aliases:
  col, collection

Available Commands:
  apply       Reconcile an offline collection in place
  build       Build a new archive from the original and desired text
  export      Export a collection to editable TOML
  plan        Inspect desired collection changes
  state       Inspect and manage collection-backed path bindings

Flags:
  -h, --help               help for col
      --state-key string   Collection state namespace key (default "anki_as_code/state/v1")

Use "anki_as_code col [command] --help" for more information about a command.

Reconcile an offline collection in place

Usage:
  anki_as_code col apply [flags]

      --collection string   Anki .colpkg archive or offline .anki2 database
  -h, --help                help for apply
      --text string         Collection root config or its containing directory

Global Flags:
      --state-key string   Collection state namespace key (default "anki_as_code/state/v1")

      --output string   Destination text directory (export) or collection archive (build)

      --state-key string   Collection state namespace key (default "anki_as_code/state/v1")
